thread:
josh: Quick heads-up — opened SDK PR that depends on an API change. PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference-sdk/pull/427
leila: glance'd — ok. do we need a DB migration? the API change touches feature flags and response shape.
josh: no DB migration. just adds a new top-level field `model_variant` to responses. console needs to map it, SDK will deserialize.
samir: console PR is open: https://github.com/redwood/console/pull/301 — i'm blocked on a helm bump and an approval from @anya for the UX part.
anya: I can review in ~2h. likely only small UX nits.
ben-ops: FYI the staging helm-release job is failing after the chart bump with: 
```
Error: UPGRADE FAILED: template: console/templates/deployment.yaml:45:50: executing "console/templates/deployment.yaml" at <.Values.image.tag>: nil pointer evaluating interface {}
```
ben-ops: looks like values.image.tag isn't set in the bumped chart (chart metadata mismatch).
merge-bot: CI summary for SDK PR #427 — unit tests: pass, integration tests: fail (console chart). details: https://ci.redwood/4372
josh: proposed safe merge order: 1) api #189 (add `model_variant`) 2) console #301 (map new field + fix chart values.image.tag) 3) sdk #427 (depends on both). prefer to canary console before full traffic.
leila: canary routing is fine from infra side — runtime team needs to enable the canary route. @samir can you request a canary slot?
samir: pinged @runtime-oncall — runtime-oncall: any canary slot today?
runtime-oncall: we have a 30m slot at 16:30 UTC. can route ~5% traffic; we'll watch latency and 5xx for 15m then escalate.
anya: reviewed console #301 — left 2 tiny nits and approved pending those fixes.
josh: perfect. i'll coordinate merge window for 17:00 UTC: steps i'll do before merging:
- confirm api #189 is merged and deployed to staging
- apply console chart fix (values.image.tag) and push canary image tag `console:v1.12.3-canary`
- kick canary at 16:30 UTC, monitor for 15m
- if green, merge console #301 and bump prod image
- merge sdk #427 and run integration smoke tests
let me know if any objections or scheduling conflicts. :thumbsup:
leila: no objections from my side. good plan.
ben-ops: i'll patch the chart values and open a small PR to the chart repo; will tag it for quick review.
samir: thanks — i'll coordinate with runtime to watch the canary metrics and stand by for approvals.
josh: thanks everyone — i'll post a final checklist ~30m before the window.
